The diamond frame retains one irregular bursting central form, all three separate fragments and all five burst rays. The two smallest triangular fragments are enlarged independently by 40 percent, with the lower fragment moved right to preserve its gap from the central form. Two short rays are lengthened to 13 mm. This is an abstract learned hazard mark, not device construction, a blast measurement or a nuclear-process model.", "canvas_mm": [170, 170]}, "teaching": "The diamond frame retains one irregular bursting central form, all three separate fragments and all five burst rays.
